point.title: Validated Diagram Generation
point.rationale: DiagramEditService and DiagramBatchService coordinate asynchronous creation, extension, scoped replacement, and alternatives against pinned input revisions. Model execution remains behind generator ports; validated submission and domain revision issuance precede application. Runs distinguish generation from application acknowledgement so ambiguous retries do not regenerate or duplicate edits.

relationships.label: Validates generated edits and issues revisions
Applies prepared revisions through versioned canvas ports
